## Personality

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is a notably capable and managing woman who possesses a sharp, observant eye for everything happening beyond her own household. Characterized by a good and kindly heart, she constantly works hard, helps the poor, and never shirks her share of labor. However, she is also officious, outspoken, and critical, taking pride in speaking her mind and nagging others to ensure nobody goes wrong. Highly pious and a believer in predestination, she strictly opposes horse racing, play-acting, and higher education for women, while also holding a distinct prejudice against [Americans](../codex/factions.md#americans). In addition to her pessimistic outlook and love of giving advice, she is a shrewd judge of human nature who excels at sewing and making prize-winning homemade butter and cheese.

## History

When [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) went to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) to fetch an orphan child, Mrs. Rachel Lynde visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and voiced her strong disapproval of taking in a stranger child. She later insulted Anne's appearance during a visit, which caused [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to fly into a rage until she later delivered a dramatic apology that completely appeased Rachel. Over time, Rachel became a supportive figure, advising [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refused to go to school, helping [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) acquire and sew a fashionable dress for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and eventually expressing her admiration for how remarkably well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) had matured. She frequently offered advice on local matters, though she cautioned [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) against forming a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Later, when a mix-up resulted in the local hall being painted bright blue instead of green, Rachel discovered the error. Following the unexpected arrival of Mr. Harrison's wife in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Rachel stepped in to assist her. After the death of her own husband, [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md), Rachel received a proposal from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), an arrangement that would allow [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to leave [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

## Quotes

> "She’s terrible skinny and homely, Marilla. Come here, child, and let me have a look at you. Lawful heart, did any one ever see such freckles? And hair as red as carrots! Come here, child, I say."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)

> "I just guess she has done well, and far be it from me to be backward in saying it. You’re a credit to your friends, Anne, that’s what, and we’re all proud of you."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P48](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0048)

> "Child, yes, I’m afraid of it. Look at his face. When you’ve seen that look as often as I have you’ll know what it means."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P7](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0007)

> "I saw Mr. Harrison chasing your Jersey out of his oats today when I was coming home from Carmody. I thought he looked pretty mad. Did he make much of a rumpus?"
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038)

> "Well, I wish you would. I guess we’ll have the supper in about a fortnight’s time. Uncle Abe Andrews is prophesying rain and storms for about that time; and that’s a pretty sure sign we’ll have fine weather."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P8](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0008)

## Relationships

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel Lynde and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) maintain a longstanding friendship despite their distinct personalities and occasional differences. Rachel frequently visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to discuss neighborhood happenings, offer advice on raising [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and attend social events like a political rally together. Following the death of Rachel's husband, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) invites Rachel to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can freely attend college.

### [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas-lynde.md)
